artifacts.summary: Re-verifies every numeric/structural claim in the task description and ROADMAP.md against the current tree; finds the ROADMAP sorry census (27/23/4/0) was already wrong at the exact commit it cites (actual 45/41/4/0), decidability matrix has grown to 8/15 (S4 and TB landed since the review), and open-task-without-roadmap-presence count grew from 20/30 to 36/46.

memory_candidates.content: cslib's official sorry counter is .claude/scripts/lean-sorry-census.sh (comment/string-aware, depth-counts nested /- -/ comments). A naive grep -c 'sorry' or a count of 'set_option warn.sorry false in' suppression-annotation sites both undercount: a single suppressed declaration can contain multiple raw sorry occurrences (observed case: 7 suppression annotations covering 19 actual sorries in one Bimodal file). Any future sorry census in this repo should run the script fresh rather than trust a prose-stated count, even one dated at a specific commit.

To verify a stale-looking metric against the exact historical commit it was dated to (not just current HEAD), use `git worktree add /tmp/<dir> <commit>` then re-run the same measurement script against the worktree path, then `git worktree remove /tmp/<dir> --force`. This distinguishes 'the figure was already wrong when written' from 'the figure drifted since it was written' -- a distinction that changes how a downstream correction task should be scoped.
